card.name: Units inside compound rate expressions
card.fires_on: The unit word or letter just before a slash and time unit in a compound rate such as mcg/kg/min or mL/min. It fires on the first or middle unit (mL, L, kg, ng, mg) right after a number or an opening bracket.
